name: @mymehq/integration-mymehq-inbox-email-worker
description: Cloudflare Email Worker companion to the mymehq.inbox integration. Receives inbound emails via Cloudflare Email Routing, parses MIME via postal-mime, HMAC-signs the JSON envelope, and POSTs to the staging server's webhook receipt endpoint. Distinct deployable from the integration Worker — same logical pipeline, two physical Workers.
